name: api-keys
title: API keys
description: Personal and service API keys with scopes for scripts and integrations: shown once, SHA-256 at rest, checksummed so secret scanners and typo checks work, expiry, last used, admin revoke, devtools panel. Zero dependencies.
author: CalmAPI
docs:
1. Signed in: POST /api/auth/api-keys { name, scopes: ['posts:read'], expiresInDays: 30 } -> { key } (shown once)
2. Use it like a session: Authorization: Bearer calm_ak_...
Scopes: * | read | <area>:read | <area>:write | <area>:* (area = first URL segment after /api). GET /api/auth/api-keys/scopes lists them.
List: GET /api/auth/api-keys, revoke: DELETE /api/auth/api-keys/:id, admins: GET|DELETE /api/admin/api-keys.
Keys cannot call /auth/* (except GET /auth/me). Settings: calm.config.js blocks: { 'api-keys': { maxKeysPerUser, maxLifetimeDays, routeScopes } }
